name_zh: 皮诺切特/智利/新自由/芝加哥/失踪/宪法/公投/奥古斯托/1980
description_zh: 奥古斯托·皮诺切特 (1915-2006) 智利总统 (1973-1990) 推行新自由经济政策，被誉为"芝加哥男孩"，在1980年通过公投宪法，建立军事独裁政权，导致许多失踪和死亡，是拉美新自由主义的实验室。
description_en: Augusto Pinochet (1915-2006) Chilean President (1973-1990) implemented neo-liberal economic policies, known as "Chicago Boys", established military dictatorship through 1980 referendum constitution, causing many disappearances and deaths, represents neo-liberal laboratory in Latin America.
reason_zh: 皮诺切特代表了拉美如何通过军事政变和新自由主义改革建立独裁政权，以及如何通过公投和宪法巩固权力，但也如何造成大量失踪和死亡。
reason_en: Pinochet represents how Latin American establishes dictatorship through military coup and neo-liberal reforms, consolidates power through referendum and constitution, but also causes many disappearances and deaths.
